seen_before_writing: code of ribosomal_check.py, vscore.py, vscore2a.py, vl_score.py, blib.py ribo helpers; the three REPORTs; aggregate facts only: 1,686 runs in 1,686 genomes (no genome has two), runs per phylum, Parvarchaeaceae = 114 runs all in Nanobdellota, 436 of 642 groups carry a run, 289 runs touch a contig end, every genome order_trusted, position_index = gid - contig first_gid. No individual run, locus or case inspected.

definition_as_implemented.marker: gene with any Pfam hit (annotations.source='pfam', ws_dpann/input/sharur.duckdb) whose name matches regexp '^ribosom(al)?_' case-insensitive (includes Ribosom_S12_S23, Ribosomal_60s, Ribosomal_S30AE, ribosomal_L24); 177,848 marked genes
definition_as_implemented.run: maximal set of marked genes on one contig in which consecutive marked genes are <= 3 positions apart (<= 2 unmarked genes between); the run span gid_start..gid_end includes the unmarked gap genes; primary set g2_m16 = runs with >= 16 MARKED genes (not >= 16 genes); 1,686 runs; span 17-45 genes, median 24
definition_as_implemented.parvarchaeaceae: 114 runs = 114 genomes (the check counts genomes, one run per genome)
definition_as_implemented.best_locus: the single locus with the largest overlap (genes of the span, gap genes included) with the run; ties -> the shorter locus; further ties -> the locus with the smaller start
definition_as_implemented.recovered: best overlap / run span >= 0.5 (equivalent to: any locus covers >= 50%)
definition_as_implemented.resolved: best overlap / run span >= 0.8 AND best overlap / best-locus length >= 0.8, evaluated on the BEST locus only; a smaller locus that satisfies both does not count if a larger-overlap locus exists
definition_as_implemented.loci: stored locus tables; single-gene loci are absent (vscore Ctx.table keeps e > s)

WCP.desc: stage-1 family words + cohesion phrases V-coh0.1

EMB.desc: embedding words on calibrated z10.6 neighbour lists, V-nest

outputs.reproduction: own scorer and ribosomal_check.score (read-only import, numba cache redirected to $RD/ribo_audit) must both give the targets exactly before sampling

sampling.strata: Parvarchaeaceae (family) as one stratum; every phylum (its non-Parvarchaeaceae runs) as one stratum; strata processed in sorted name order; within a stratum candidates sorted by run_id
sampling.allocation: largest-remainder rounding of N x (stratum count / total count), remainders ordered by size then stratum name
sampling.unresolved_per_output: N = 40 from that output's unresolved runs, allocation by the output's unresolved counts; rng numpy default_rng(20261113 + k), k = 0 TOK, 1 WCP, 2 EMB; rng.choice without replacement per stratum
sampling.unresolved_in_all_three: N = 20 from runs unresolved in all three outputs; default_rng(20261116); each case is evaluated under all three outputs
sampling.controls: N = 20 resolved runs per output, allocation proportional to that output's UNRESOLVED stratum counts (phylum-matched to its failures); a stratum short of resolved runs gives its excess to the others by largest remainder of their resolved counts; default_rng(20261117 + k)
sampling.overlap: samples are drawn independently; a run may appear in several samples

evidence.window: the run span plus 10 genes on each side, clipped to the contig
evidence.groups: $RD/lineagefree/groups/emb_hom_average_t0.75.parquet (642 lineage-free genome groups); the case's own group is removed from every count and expectation below (leave-own-group-out)
evidence.Lambda: Lambda(n, E) = n ln(n/E) - n + E nats for n > E, else 0 (Poisson log-likelihood ratio, the ws_vocab statistic)

A_flank_association.statistic: flank of a run = genes within 10 positions outside the run on its contig. n_X = groups with >= 1 genome whose flank holds a gene of family X; E_X = sum over groups of [1 - prod over the group's genomes WITH a run of (1 - min(1, c_X(g) W_g / (N_g - L_g)))], c_X(g) = copies of X in genome g outside its run, W_g = flank genes, N_g = genes, L_g = run span
A_flank_association.call: X is run-associated iff n' >= 3 and Lambda(n', E') >= 10 (own group removed); 10 nats = the null-calibrated word cost of ws_vocab stage 1

B_other_kind_member.statistic: among genomes with a run: G_X = groups in which family X occurs, G_in_X = groups in which >= 1 copy of X lies inside a run (own group removed from both)
B_other_kind_member.call: a marked run member is OTHER-KIND iff (G_X' >= 5 and G_in_X'/G_X' < 0.5) or (protein length > 2 x the median length of all marked genes with the same top-scoring marker)

C_junction_recurrence.statistic: family pair (X, Y): n = groups (all 3,564 genomes) with >= 1 genome in which distinct genes of X and Y lie <= 3 positions apart on one contig; E = sum over groups of [1 - prod over genomes (1 - min(1, 2*3*c_X c_Y / m_g))] (ws_vocab expectation, w = 3); own group removed
C_junction_recurrence.call: recurrent iff n' >= 3 and Lambda >= 10; testable iff X and Y each occur in >= 10 groups other than the own group
C_junction_recurrence.break: a junction between core positions p and p+1 is a BREAK iff no gene pair crossing it (x <= p < y, y - x <= 3, both in the core) is recurrent and at least one crossing pair is testable

evidence.D_gene_call_anomaly: (i) two adjacent genes with the same family token or the same top marker; (ii) a gene shorter than 0.5 x the median length of its family token (families with >= 5 genes); genome order flags are all clean so they cannot apply
evidence.E_contig_edge: the core touches the first or last gene of its contig

rubric.notation: core = genes whose coverage is required (recall); adm = genes a locus may contain without penalty (precision); best = locus with the largest overlap with core (ties shorter, then smaller start); resolved at a state iff |best & core| >= 0.8 |core| and |best & adm| >= 0.8 |best|
rubric.order: cumulative states; a case takes the label of the FIRST state at which it is resolved; if none, the data check, then the junction state, then a method label

S0b.label: DEF_SCORING
S0b.rule: some locus of the output has overlap >= 0.8 |run| and >= 0.8 of its own length inside the run, but it is not the largest-overlap locus

S1.label: DEF_NEARBY_RIBO
S1.rule: core = run; adm = R5: the run extended outward through marked genes separated by <= 5 unmarked genes (iterated), including the genes between

S2.label: DEF_OTHER_KIND
S2.rule: core = the maximal g2 piece of the run rebuilt from its marked genes minus OTHER-KIND members, the piece with the largest overlap with the run (unchanged if none); adm = S1 adm (removed members stay admissible)

S3.label: DEF_ASSOC_FLANK
S3.rule: core = S2 core; adm = S2 adm extended outward on each side through genes that are marked or of run-associated families, bridging <= 2 consecutive genes that are neither, at most 10 genes beyond the S2 adm edge

DATA.applies: unresolved at S3 with |best & core| < 0.8 |core| at S3
DATA.DATA_CONTIG_EDGE: core touches a contig end and every core gene outside the best locus lies between the best locus and that end
DATA.DATA_GENE_CALL: a core gene adjacent to the best locus but outside it, or a core gene in no locus, lies within 1 position of a gene-call anomaly (D)

S4.label: DEF_JUNCTION
S4.applies: unresolved at S3, coverage failure at S3, data check negative
S4.rule: core = the piece of the S3 core between BREAK junctions with the largest overlap with the S3 best locus; adm = S3 adm

METHOD.applies: everything else; evaluated at the S3 state
METHOD.METHOD_SPLIT: |best & core| < 0.8 |core| and, among core genes outside the best locus, those inside another locus of the output >= those in no locus
METHOD.METHOD_UNCOVERED: |best & core| < 0.8 |core| and core genes in no locus outnumber those in other loci
METHOD.METHOD_EXTENSION: coverage met, precision < 0.8 even with nearby ribosomal genes and run-associated flank genes admissible: the locus extends into genes with no measured association
METHOD.flag_ext: coverage labels carry +ext when S3 precision < 0.8 as well

rubric.OTHER: evidence not computable, or manual reading of the layout shows the automated evidence was computed on a wrong premise; each listed individually with the reason
rubric.manual_review: every sampled case's diagram is read; disagreements are recorded as notes; a label is changed only for a demonstrable computation error, which is then fixed in code for all cases

shares.definition: DEF_SCORING + DEF_NEARBY_RIBO + DEF_OTHER_KIND + DEF_ASSOC_FLANK + DEF_JUNCTION; also reported without DEF_SCORING and without DEF_JUNCTION
shares.interval: Wilson 95% score interval on the sampled proportion; a census of all unresolved runs with the same automated rules is reported alongside as a check

full_set.nearby_runs: over all 1,686 runs: pairs of g2_m16 runs within 5 genes (<= 5 intervening genes) on one contig; runs with any other marked gene, any g2 cluster of >= 2 marked genes, and any g2_m8 run within <= 5 intervening unmarked genes outside the span
full_set.sensitivity: resolved counts of the three outputs on all 1,686 runs under V0b (any locus), V1 (S1), V2 (S1+S2), V3 (S1+S2+S3, the candidate fairer definition), V4 (V3 + S4 pieces); the standing definition is unchanged
